## Goal

Add an activity to a day of @trip.timeline.

## Steps

1. Open @trip.timeline#add-activity and tap
   **Add**.
2. Fill in @activity.editor.
   - Save goes to @activity.detail.
   - Cancel returns to
     the timeline.
3. Review the activity.

Afterwards the day shows it on @trip.timeline.
